module: Flowgraph node 'Get Custom Vehicle Data' (once_instant category). Intended to read the dynamic fields of a vehicle (pin vehId) into custom output pins; the current implementation only reads the fields waypoints, routeSpeed and risk.
notes: BUG: in workOnce, the condition tests 'veh.wayponits' (typo) and assigns 'wps', a variable never defined in this function (nil): the waypoints output never receives the list, and convertStringToTable is never called.
The loop over pinOut that was supposed to copy each dynamic field is empty (only comments).
If an output pin waypoints, routeSpeed or risk does not exist, indexing nil raises an error.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

convertStringToTable.desc: Splits a comma-separated string into a table of strings.

workOnce.desc: Looks up the vehicle by id and copies routeSpeed and risk (converted to number) to the output pins of the same name; the waypoints part is broken (see notes).
